The collaboration supports researchers in meeting data policies during the submission process. No further details on the scope of the extension were provided in the announcement.

ip_top_stories.title: CJEU delivers pastiche-style judgment on … pastiche
ip_top_stories.summary: The Court of Justice of the European Union has issued a significant ruling clarifying the scope of the pastiche exception under EU copyright law. The IPKat reports on the judgment, which has implications for how courts interpret creative borrowing and parody-adjacent uses of copyrighted works. The decision is relevant to ongoing debates about AI-generated content and permissible use of training data.
